LanguageData.PGM_RefreshInterval_Tip: How often cached monitoring data should refresh while the map is active. This setting does not change the game's power simulation.
LanguageData.PGM_SampleInterval_Tip: Planned interval for future aggregate history samples. One in-game hour is 2,500 ticks.
LanguageData.PGM_Retention_Tip: Maximum in-game history retention planned for the collector. This setting has no effect until historical monitoring is implemented.
LanguageData.PGM_HighLoad_Tip: Planned threshold relative to connected installed generation capacity. Current output and nominal capacity will be shown separately.
